grades.main_gap: Stabilization of M_n (finiteness of the prime ground, Section 5) is not proven: the induction on τ≤|S_1| is only sketched with no formulated hypothesis, and the author concedes 'Given time, we accept finiteness of final ground as proved.'
grades.notes: Sections 1–4 and 6 are essentially correct and rigorous: blocker framework, Lemma A, pure-multiple mechanism, fixed-ground termination via up-set growth, and the L-periodicity finish (one small directional wobble in §6, repairable). Section 5 is exploratory working notes with abandoned attempts; the central stabilization lemma is unproven, and everything depends on it.
